definitions.explanation: A medical term for inflammation of the skin, covering a range of conditions such as eczema, contact dermatitis, and atopic dermatitis. Used in medical contexts and health reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{皮膚炎|ひふえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I developed dermatitis on my hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦アトピー→アトピー：23012_atopii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{皮膚炎|ひふえん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Atopic dermatitis is common in children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{皮膚炎|ひふえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor diagnosed contact dermatitis and prescribed some medicine.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧ (skin) and {炎|えん} (inflammation). The suffix {〜炎|えん} attaches to body parts to form the names of inflammatory conditions, as in ⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧ (pneumonia) and ⟦{胃炎|いえん}→胃炎：25491_ien⟧ (gastritis).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮膚炎|ひふえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop dermatitis
- {皮膚炎|ひふえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause/trigger dermatitis
- ⟦アトピー→アトピー：23012_atopii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{皮膚炎|ひふえん}: atopic dermatitis
- ⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{皮膚炎|ひふえん}: contact dermatitis
- {皮膚炎|ひふえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment of dermatitis

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧: skin
- ⟦{湿疹|しっしん}→湿疹：06951_shisshin⟧: eczema, rash — often used interchangeably in everyday speech, but more specifically refers to the visible lesions
- ⟦{炎症|えんしょう}→炎症：05978_enshou⟧: inflammation — the general medical term
- ⟦かぶれ→かぶれ：25271_kabure⟧: skin rash (from contact with an irritant) — a more colloquial term
